say.zh: 真实芯片里不少模块面积固定、宽高可选。形状一变，邻居就要跟着挪；摆法也会反过来限制形状。
say.en: Many real modules have fixed area but selectable aspect ratio. Reshaping moves neighbors; placement also constrains shape.

narration.zh: 本课要回答三个问题：形状候选怎么列？哪个组合能进固定外框？结论的适用范围到哪里？
narration.en: We will enumerate shape candidates, determine which combinations fit a fixed outline, and establish exactly where our conclusions apply.

say.zh: 先看一个贯穿全课的例子：A面积为六。把它变窄，会先碰到谁？怎样重摆，又怎样证明不能更好？
say.en: A running example: A has area six. Narrow it, who collides first? How to repack, and how to prove no better layout?

title.en: Why shape and placement are decided together

narration.zh: 先看一个贯穿全课的例子：A面积为六。把它变窄，会先碰到谁？怎样重摆，又怎样证明不能更好？
narration.en: Our running example is block A, with area six. If we make it narrower, which block will it hit? How can we repack the layout, and how can we prove that a result cannot be improved?

say.zh: 只让 A 调整形状，其余四块尺寸固定；都要放进十乘八外框，目标是合法且包围盒最小。
say.en: Only A may reshape; other dimensions stay fixed. Require legality within the ten-by-eight outline, then minimize bounding-box area.

title.zh: 先限定问题：形状与摆放一起决定结果

chapter.zh: 先限定问题：形状与摆放一起决定结果

narration.zh: 只让 A 调整形状，其余四块尺寸固定；都要放进十乘八外框，目标是合法且包围盒最小。
narration.en: Only A may change shape initially. The other four blocks keep fixed dimensions. All blocks must fit a ten-by-eight outline, and we minimize valid bounding-box area.

say.zh: 本例宽高取正整数，坐标落在整数网格；后面的最优证明同时依赖这两条。
say.en: Dimensions are positive integers; coordinates lie on the integer grid. The optimality proof depends on both conditions.

narration.zh: 本例宽高取正整数，坐标落在整数网格；后面的最优证明同时依赖这两条。

say.zh: A 面积固定为六。宽度选定后，高度必须等于六除以宽度，不能独立选择。
say.en: A has fixed area six. Once width is chosen, height must equal six divided by width.

title.zh: 形状约束：不是任意拉伸

chapter.zh: 形状约束：不是任意拉伸

narration.zh: A 面积固定为六。宽度选定后，高度必须等于六除以宽度，不能独立选择。
narration.en: A's area stays six. Once its width is chosen, height must be six divided by width. These two dimensions cannot be chosen independently.

say.zh: 把高度代入宽高比条件，得到图上的宽度区间；再取满足面积的整数因数对。
say.en: Substitute height into the ratio limits to obtain this width interval; then select integer factor pairs.

title.zh: 形状约束：不是任意拉伸

chapter.zh: 形状约束：不是任意拉伸

narration.zh: 把高度代入宽高比条件，得到图上的宽度区间；再取满足面积的整数因数对。
narration.en: Substitute that height into the aspect-ratio bounds to obtain an interval of allowed widths. Then retain the integer factor pairs that preserve area.

say.zh: 一乘六和六乘一因比例超界被排除；整数候选只剩二乘三与三乘二。
say.en: The ratio bounds exclude one by six and six by one, leaving two by three and three by two.

title.zh: 形状约束：不是任意拉伸

chapter.zh: 形状约束：不是任意拉伸

narration.zh: 一乘六和六乘一因比例超界被排除；整数候选只剩二乘三与三乘二。
narration.en: One by six and six by one violate the aspect-ratio bounds. Only two by three and three by two remain as integer candidates.

say.zh: 连续模型还有区间内的非整数宽度。平滑变形可以示意它，却不能增加整数实验选项。
say.en: The continuous model also permits noninteger widths. Smooth motion illustrates those choices without adding integer-lab options.

title.zh: 形状约束：不是任意拉伸

narration.en: The continuous model also permits noninteger widths within the interval. A smooth animation can illustrate them, but they are not additional options in the integer experiment.

say.zh: 原布局合法，包围盒九乘三等于二十七；减去模块总面积二十三，盒内空余四。
say.en: The legal baseline box has area twenty-seven. Subtract total block area twenty-three to obtain four empty units.

narration.zh: 原布局合法，包围盒九乘三等于二十七；减去模块总面积二十三，盒内空余四。
narration.en: The original placement is valid. Its box is nine by three, with area twenty-seven. Subtract total block area twenty-three to obtain four units of empty box area.

narration.en: Next we change only A's shape. Predict whether the complete layout will remain valid.

say.zh: 现在只把A改成二乘三。它右侧空出一列，上方却多占了一行。D还没动，所以这次变形会碰到D。
say.en: Change only A to two by three. Space opens on the right, but a new strip is occupied above.

title.zh: 碰撞：从占用区间算出来

chapter.zh: 碰撞：从占用区间算出来

narration.zh: 现在只把A改成二乘三。它右侧空出一列，上方却多占了一行。D还没动，所以这次变形会碰到D。
narration.en: Change only A to two by three. It frees a column on the right but occupies an extra row above. D has not moved, so the reshaped A now overlaps D.

say.zh: 新增区域与 D 的交集，横向宽二、纵向高一，因此重叠面积为二。
say.en: The intersection with D has width two and height one, so its overlap area is two.

title.zh: 碰撞：从占用区间算出来

chapter.zh: 碰撞：从占用区间算出来

narration.zh: 新增区域与 D 的交集，横向宽二、纵向高一，因此重叠面积为二。
narration.en: The new region intersects D over width two and height one. The overlap area is therefore two.

say.zh: 贴边时，共同宽度或高度为零，所以允许；这里两个方向都有正长度，不能通过。
say.en: Boundary contact has a zero overlap dimension. Here both dimensions are positive, so the placement fails.

title.zh: 碰撞：从占用区间算出来

chapter.zh: 碰撞：从占用区间算出来

narration.zh: 贴边时，共同宽度或高度为零，所以允许；这里两个方向都有正长度，不能通过。
narration.en: Boundary contact has zero intersection length in at least one direction and is allowed. Here both intersection lengths are positive, so the placement fails.

say.zh: 把 D 右移，虽然躲开 A，却进入 B。修复旧冲突后，必须重新检查所有邻居。
say.en: Moving D right clears A but enters B. After repairing one pair, recheck every neighbor.

title.zh: 修复：检查所有邻居，再比较目标

chapter.zh: 修复：检查所有邻居，再比较目标

narration.zh: 把 D 右移，虽然躲开 A，却进入 B。修复旧冲突后，必须重新检查所有邻居。
narration.en: Moving D to the right avoids A, but overlaps B. After repairing one conflict, check every other neighbor again.

say.zh: D 放在 B 上方时，底边不能低于三；取最低允许值三，就与 B 贴边。
say.en: Above B, D’s bottom must be at least three. Choosing the lowest allowed value makes their boundaries touch.

title.zh: 修复：检查所有邻居，再比较目标

chapter.zh: 修复：检查所有邻居，再比较目标

narration.zh: D 放在 B 上方时，底边不能低于三；取最低允许值三，就与 B 贴边。
narration.en: Place D above B. Its bottom edge cannot be below three. At the lowest permitted height, three, it touches B without overlap.

say.zh: 布局恢复合法，但高度涨到四，包围盒变成三十六。可行性通过，不等于目标改善。
say.en: Legality returns, but height becomes four and box area becomes thirty-six. Feasibility does not imply improvement.

title.zh: 修复：检查所有邻居，再比较目标

chapter.zh: 修复：检查所有邻居，再比较目标

narration.zh: 布局恢复合法，但高度涨到四，包围盒变成三十六。可行性通过，不等于目标改善。
narration.en: Validity is restored, but box height increases to four and box area becomes thirty-six. Feasibility does not imply objective improvement.

say.zh: B 左移贴住 A，收紧它们之间的水平空隙。
say.en: Move B left to touch A, closing their horizontal gap.

title.zh: 重摆：找出谁还撑着边界

chapter.zh: 重摆：找出谁还撑着边界

narration.zh: B 左移贴住 A，收紧它们之间的水平空隙。
narration.en: Move B left until it touches A, removing the horizontal gap between them.

say.zh: C 再左移贴住 B，为 D 准备较低的落点。
say.en: Then move C left to touch B and prepare a lower resting position for D.

title.zh: 重摆：找出谁还撑着边界

chapter.zh: 重摆：找出谁还撑着边界

narration.zh: C 再左移贴住 B，为 D 准备较低的落点。
narration.en: Move C left to touch B, preparing a lower landing position for D.

say.zh: D 移到四、二，贴住 C 的顶部和 B 的右边缘，包围盒回到二十七。
say.en: Move D to four, two. Its bottom touches C’s top; its left edge touches B’s right edge.

title.zh: 重摆：找出谁还撑着边界

chapter.zh: 重摆：找出谁还撑着边界

narration.zh: D 移到四、二，贴住 C 的顶部和 B 的右边缘，包围盒回到二十七。
narration.en: Place D at four, two. It touches C's top and B's right edge, reducing box area back to twenty-seven.

chapter.zh: 碰撞：从占用区间算出来

say.zh: 先找出仍限制包围盒的那一块。
say.en: Identify the block that still limits the bounding box.

question.prompt: 只收紧 B、C、D 仍为27，谁还决定盒宽？
replies: A仍在原点，E的右边缘9仍决定宽度。
面积和给下界，不能直接给当前盒宽。
外框是容量，当前包围盒由实际边缘决定。

narration.zh: 先找出仍限制包围盒的那一块。
narration.en: Which block still determines the outer edge of the bounding box?

say.zh: 当前 A 仍在原点，E 把最右边撑到九；只收紧其余模块，盒宽仍是九。
say.en: With A still at the origin, E keeps the right boundary at nine; tightening other blocks leaves the width unchanged.

title.zh: 重摆：找出谁还撑着边界

chapter.zh: 重摆：找出谁还撑着边界

narration.zh: 当前 A 仍在原点，E 把最右边撑到九；只收紧其余模块，盒宽仍是九。
narration.en: A remains at the origin, while E extends the right edge to nine. Tightening only the other blocks leaves box width unchanged at nine.

say.zh: 先把 D 移到零、三，腾出 C 上方的二乘二区域。
say.en: First move D to zero, three, freeing a two-by-two destination above C.

title.zh: 空间交换：比较落定后的布局

chapter.zh: 空间交换：比较落定后的布局

narration.zh: 先把 D 移到零、三，腾出 C 上方的二乘二区域。
narration.en: Move D to zero, three, freeing a two-by-two region above C.

say.zh: 再把 E 放进空位，右边界退到六、高度为四，得到合法面积二十四。
say.en: Move E into that space. Width becomes six and height four, giving a legal area of twenty-four.

title.zh: 空间交换：比较落定后的布局

chapter.zh: 空间交换：比较落定后的布局

narration.zh: 再把 E 放进空位，右边界退到六、高度为四，得到合法面积二十四。
narration.en: Place E in that space. The right edge retreats to six, and height is four. The valid bounding area is twenty-four.

say.zh: 这条编辑序列先腾位、再压紧，中间面积暂时变大；不能把中间动作当最终结果。
say.en: This editing sequence first frees space and then compacts it. Its temporary increase is not the final result.

title.zh: 空间交换：比较落定后的布局

chapter.zh: 空间交换：比较落定后的布局

narration.zh: 这条编辑序列先腾位、再压紧，中间面积暂时变大；不能把中间动作当最终结果。
narration.en: This edit sequence makes room before compacting. Its intermediate area increases temporarily. Evaluate the final placement separately from the intermediate edits.

say.zh: 动画说明每次编辑的端点，不保证搬动途中的每一帧都是无碰撞路径。
say.en: The animation explains edit endpoints; it does not certify a collision-free physical transport path.

say.zh: 对这些合法布局，模块总面积和外框都没变，外框密度仍是二十三除以八十，不能证明压紧有效。
say.en: Across legal placements, block area and outline stay fixed. Their unchanged density, twenty-three over eighty, cannot demonstrate compaction.

title.zh: 指标：分母决定你在评价什么

chapter.zh: 指标：分母决定你在评价什么

narration.zh: 对这些合法布局，模块总面积和外框都没变，外框密度仍是二十三除以八十，不能证明压紧有效。
narration.en: For these valid layouts, block area and outline area are unchanged. Outline utilization stays twenty-three over eighty and cannot measure the compaction.

say.zh: 包围盒密度则从约百分之八十五点二，提高到九十五点八，因为分母从二十七降到二十四。
say.en: Packing density rises from about eighty-five point two to ninety-five point eight percent because its denominator falls from twenty-seven to twenty-four.

title.zh: 指标：分母决定你在评价什么

chapter.zh: 指标：分母决定你在评价什么

narration.zh: 包围盒密度则从约百分之八十五点二，提高到九十五点八，因为分母从二十七降到二十四。
narration.en: Packing density rises from about eighty-five point two percent to ninety-five point eight percent, because bounding area falls from twenty-seven to twenty-four.

say.zh: 合法布局的包围盒，至少包含二十三的模块面积；这是任何摆法都不能突破的下界。
say.en: A legal bounding box must contain total block area twenty-three. That gives a lower bound for every placement.

narration.zh: 合法布局的包围盒，至少包含二十三的模块面积；这是任何摆法都不能突破的下界。
narration.en: A valid bounding box must contain total block area twenty-three. This gives a lower bound for every placement.

say.zh: 整数尺寸加整数坐标，使包围盒宽高也是整数。接下来只需排除面积二十三。

narration.en: Integer dimensions and coordinates make the box width and height integers too. To improve on twenty-four, we now only need to exclude area twenty-three.

say.en: Twenty-three has no positive integer factors except one and itself, leaving only one-by-twenty-three or twenty-three-by-one boxes.

narration.zh: 二十三除了一和自己，没有别的整数因数；盒子只能是一乘二十三，或二十三乘一。
narration.en: Twenty-three is prime. Its only positive integer factors are one and twenty-three, so such a box would have dimensions one by twenty-three or twenty-three by one.

say.zh: 这两种长条都放不下二乘二的 C，所以二十三不可能，下一档至少是二十四。
say.en: Neither strip can contain the two-by-two C block. Area twenty-three is impossible, so the next integer area is twenty-four.

narration.en: Neither thin box can contain the fixed two-by-two block C. Area twenty-three is impossible, so the integer-model lower bound rises to twenty-four.

say.zh: 我们已经有合法的六乘四布局。下界与见证都是二十四，因此这个整数模型的最优值就是二十四。
say.en: A legal six-by-four witness attains twenty-four. Matching the lower bound proves the integer model’s optimum is twenty-four.

narration.en: We already have a valid six-by-four placement. Its area matches the lower bound at twenty-four, proving optimality for this integer model.

say.zh: 允许小数后，盒面积不必逐个整数跳变，刚才排除二十三的证明就不能直接沿用。

narration.zh: 允许小数后，盒面积不必逐个整数跳变，刚才排除二十三的证明就不能直接沿用。
narration.en: With noninteger dimensions or coordinates, bounding area need not advance in integer steps. The preceding exclusion argument cannot simply be reused for the continuous model.

say.zh: 现在A和B都是软模块：A面积六、B面积十二，各有两个整数形状；C固定三乘一。
say.en: Now A and B are soft: areas six and twelve, two integer shapes each; C is fixed three-by-one.

title.zh: 多软模块：形状前沿与联合优化
title.en: Multi-soft shape frontier and joint search

chapter.zh: 多软模块：形状前沿与联合优化

narration.zh: 现在A和B都是软模块：A面积六、B面积十二，各有两个整数形状；C固定三乘一。
narration.en: Now both A and B are soft blocks. Their areas are six and twelve, and each has two integer shape choices. C remains fixed at three by one.

say.zh: 四种组合，得到的宽高依次是六乘四、五乘五、七乘四、六乘五。六乘四不比七乘四和六乘五更宽或更高，所以后两种可以删掉。但五乘五更窄，不能一起删。前沿就留下六乘四和五乘五。
say.en: Four combos give six-four, five-five, seven-four, six-five. Two are dominated; the frontier keeps six-four and five-five.

title.zh: 多软模块：形状前沿与联合优化
title.en: Multi-soft shape frontier and joint search

chapter.zh: 多软模块：形状前沿与联合优化
chapter.en: Multi-soft shape frontier and joint search

narration.zh: 四种组合，得到的宽高依次是六乘四、五乘五、七乘四、六乘五。六乘四不比七乘四和六乘五更宽或更高，所以后两种可以删掉。但五乘五更窄，不能一起删。前沿就留下六乘四和五乘五。
narration.en: The four shape combinations give six by four, five by five, seven by four, and six by five. Six by four dominates the last two: it is no worse in either dimension. Five by five is narrower, so it must remain. Keep both six by four and five by five on the frontier.

say.zh: 放进五乘五外框：面积最小的24、宽6放不下；(5,5)放得进。只留最小面积的贪心会失败。
say.en: In the five-by-five outline the smallest 24 (six-four) is too wide; five-five fits. Greedy-by-area fails.

narration.zh: 放进五乘五外框：面积最小的24、宽6放不下；(5,5)放得进。只留最小面积的贪心会失败。
narration.en: In a five-by-five outline, the area-twenty-four candidate is too wide. The five-by-five candidate fits. Keeping only the smallest-area shape would incorrectly discard the feasible solution.

say.zh: 前沿候选要能回溯：每个子树选了哪个形状、坐标落在哪里，再交给第二课检查。
say.en: Each frontier candidate must backtrace: which shape each subtree took, where blocks land, then Lab2 checks.

narration.en: Each frontier candidate needs backtracking information: which child shapes were selected and where their blocks are placed. Reconstruct coordinates, then validate the result using Lab two.

say.zh: 接上一课：邻居可以是换序列对，也可以改某软模块形状。三配置同种子同预算对照。
say.en: From the last lesson: a neighbor may swap the pair or reshape one soft module. Three configs, same seeds and budget.

narration.en: Return to search. A neighbor may edit the sequence pair or change a soft block's shape. Compare the three configurations with the same seeds and search budget.

say.zh: 冻结基线只评一次；只搜形状找到25；形状加拓扑也找到25。收益归因只针对这组数据。
say.en: The frozen baseline evaluates once; shapes-only finds 25; shapes plus topology also finds 25. Attribution is for this data only.

narration.zh: 冻结基线只评一次；只搜形状找到25；形状加拓扑也找到25。收益归因只针对这组数据。
narration.en: The frozen baseline is evaluated once. Shape-only search finds twenty-five, and joint shape-and-topology search also finds twenty-five. Attribute improvements only to what this controlled experiment actually demonstrates.

say.zh: 而且 A 保持原形状也能达到二十四，不能把相对原布局的改进，全归给软模块变形。
say.en: A can retain its original shape and also attain twenty-four. Improvement over the baseline is not proof of a reshaping advantage.

narration.zh: 而且 A 保持原形状也能达到二十四，不能把相对原布局的改进，全归给软模块变形。
narration.en: A can also retain its original shape in an area-twenty-four placement. We cannot attribute every improvement over the original layout to reshaping A.

say.zh: 面积改为八，连续宽度在二到四；宽三虽在区间内，高八除以三却不是整数，不能入选。
say.en: For area eight, continuous widths span two to four; width three gives fractional height eight-thirds, excluding it from integer candidates.

narration.zh: 面积改为八，连续宽度在二到四；宽三虽在区间内，高八除以三却不是整数，不能入选。
narration.en: Change the area to eight. Continuous width may range from two to four. Width three lies in that interval, but height eight thirds is not an integer, so this shape is excluded from the integer choices.

say.en: In the lab, identify the binding constraint, the block setting the box boundary, and the evidence supporting any optimality claim.

captions.text: 真实芯片里不少模块面积固定、宽高可选。
形状一变，邻居就要跟着挪；摆法也会反过来限制形状。
这是本课程的最后一课。
前几课的检查、评分、解码和搜索，在这一课要一起用上。
本课要回答三个问题：形状候选怎么列？
哪个组合能进固定外框？
结论的适用范围到哪里？
先看一个贯穿全课的例子：A面积为六。
把它变窄，会先碰到谁？
怎样重摆，又怎样证明不能更好？
只让 A 调整形状，其余四块尺寸固定；都要放进十乘八外框，目标是合法且包围盒最小。
本例宽高取正整数，坐标落在整数网格；后面的最优证明同时依赖这两条。
A 面积固定为六。
宽度选定后，高度必须等于六除以宽度，不能独立选择。
把高度代入宽高比条件，得到图上的宽度区间；再取满足面积的整数因数对。
一乘六和六乘一因比例超界被排除；整数候选只剩二乘三与三乘二。
连续模型还有区间内的非整数宽度。
平滑变形可以示意它，却不能增加整数实验选项。
原布局合法，包围盒九乘三等于二十七；减去模块总面积二十三，盒内空余四。
下一步只改变 A 的形状。
先预测整个布局是否仍合法。
现在只把A改成二乘三。
它右侧空出一列，上方却多占了一行。
D还没动，所以这次变形会碰到D。
新增区域与 D 的交集，横向宽二、纵向高一，因此重叠面积为二。
贴边时，共同宽度或高度为零，所以允许；这里两个方向都有正长度，不能通过。
把 D 右移，虽然躲开 A，却进入 B。
修复旧冲突后，必须重新检查所有邻居。
D 放在 B 上方时，底边不能低于三；取最低允许值三，就与 B 贴边。
布局恢复合法，但高度涨到四，包围盒变成三十六。
可行性通过，不等于目标改善。
B 左移贴住 A，收紧它们之间的水平空隙。
C 再左移贴住 B，为 D 准备较低的落点。
D 移到四、二，贴住 C 的顶部和 B 的右边缘，包围盒回到二十七。
先找出仍限制包围盒的那一块。
当前 A 仍在原点，E 把最右边撑到九；只收紧其余模块，盒宽仍是九。
先把 D 移到零、三，腾出 C 上方的二乘二区域。
再把 E 放进空位，右边界退到六、高度为四，得到合法面积二十四。
这条编辑序列先腾位、再压紧，中间面积暂时变大；不能把中间动作当最终结果。
动画说明每次编辑的端点，不保证搬动途中的每一帧都是无碰撞路径。
对这些合法布局，模块总面积和外框都没变，外框密度仍是二十三除以八十，不能证明压紧有效。
包围盒密度则从约百分之八十五点二，提高到九十五点八，因为分母从二十七降到二十四。
合法布局的包围盒，至少包含二十三的模块面积；这是任何摆法都不能突破的下界。
整数尺寸加整数坐标，使包围盒宽高也是整数。
接下来只需排除面积二十三。
二十三除了一和自己，没有别的整数因数；盒子只能是一乘二十三，或二十三乘一。
这两种长条都放不下二乘二的 C，所以二十三不可能，下一档至少是二十四。
我们已经有合法的六乘四布局。
下界与见证都是二十四，因此这个整数模型的最优值就是二十四。
允许小数后，盒面积不必逐个整数跳变，刚才排除二十三的证明就不能直接沿用。
现在A和B都是软模块：A面积六、B面积十二，各有两个整数形状；C固定三乘一。
四种组合，得到的宽高依次是六乘四、五乘五、七乘四、六乘五。
六乘四不比七乘四和六乘五更宽或更高，所以后两种可以删掉。
但五乘五更窄，不能一起删。
前沿就留下六乘四和五乘五。
放进五乘五外框：面积最小的24、宽6放不下；(5,5)放得进。
只留最小面积的贪心会失败。
前沿候选要能回溯：每个子树选了哪个形状、坐标落在哪里，再交给第二课检查。
接上一课：邻居可以是换序列对，也可以改某软模块形状。
三配置同种子同预算对照。
冻结基线只评一次；只搜形状找到25；形状加拓扑也找到25。
收益归因只针对这组数据。
而且 A 保持原形状也能达到二十四，不能把相对原布局的改进，全归给软模块变形。
面积改为八，连续宽度在二到四；宽三虽在区间内，高八除以三却不是整数，不能入选。
独立练习要解释三件事：哪条约束卡住选择，谁撑住盒边界，以及你的最优结论靠什么证明。
